new_today_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil (UCO) Market 2026: SAF Feedstock Economics, Supply Risk & Policy Outlook
new_today_news.summary: Analysis of UCO market dynamics for SAF production, discussing structural tension between policy priorities for waste-based feedstocks and limited UCO supply pools, with intense competition between biodiesel, renewable diesel, and SAF producers for limited feedstock availability.

new_today_news.headline: GFL Environmental Announces Proposed $750M Senior Notes Offering Due 2031; Funds SECURE Waste Acquisition and Growth Initiatives
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental announced a proposed private offering of US$750 million in senior notes due 2031. GFL intends to use proceeds to repay revolving credit facility amounts and fund the previously announced acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp. and pursue other growth initiatives.

recent_news.headline: European HVO Markets: The Feedstock Constraint Behind the Compliance Push
recent_news.summary: May-June 2026 analysis showing feedstock access—particularly UCO and Annex IX materials—has become the binding constraint in European renewable diesel markets, with finished product prices declining while raw material costs remain firm.

recent_news.headline: Why Darling Ingredients' Diamond Green Diesel Quietly Matters for Everyday Fuels
recent_news.summary: Overview of Diamond Green Diesel's operations using used cooking oil and animal fats feedstocks with hydroprocessing technology, serving low-carbon fuel markets in California, Canada and Europe.
